english.title: Sexual activity with an animal

english.legislation: Contrary to section 69 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from 29th September 2026, replacing the previous offences provided by section 69 (see H5821 / H5822 / H5823) due to changes made by the Crime and Policing Act 2026. The purpose of the change is intended to ensure that a wider range of animal sexual abuse is criminalised under the remit of one offence, including sexual touching of an animal, whether or not the animal is living or dead.
(ii) Touching is sexual if a reasonable person would consider that because of its nature it may be sexual and because of its circumstances or the purpose of any person in relation to it (or both) it is sexual.
(iii) A person convicted of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates' court, see section 69(3) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
